note: ORACLE-INFORMED reference checks, written by the bed author from spec/DESIGN.md with knowledge of the injected bugs. Used only to audit the clean build against the spec (audit-clean.mjs) and as an upper-bound calibration; never given to any arm.

checks.rule: HUD shows the current score
HUD shows the current lives
HUD shows the current keys
HUD shows the current coins
HUD shows the time left
HUD shows the dash status
Score is never negative and at most 999,999
Score changes only by the listed amounts
checks.expect: cur.state.score - prev.state.score == 100 * count(cur.state.events, e => e == 'coin') + 5000 * count(cur.state.events, e => e == 'gem') + 20000 * count(cur.state.events, e => e == 'relic') + 500 * count(cur.state.events, e => e == 'heart-bonus')

checks.rule: Spikes cost 500 points, the score stops at 0
Completion adds 10 points per tick left
At most one move (step or 2-tile dash) per tick
checks.expect: abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= (includes(cur.state.events, 'dash') ? 2 : 1) && (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y)

checks.rule: Nothing else happens in the tick the game pauses
Nothing moves while paused
checks.expect: cur.state.player == prev.state.player && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.enemies == prev.state.enemies

checks.rule: Paused means the pause menu is open
A dash stops before the first solid tile
checks.expect: tile(prev, (prev.state.player.x + cur.state.player.x) / 2, (prev.state.player.y + cur.state.player.y) / 2) != '#' && tile(prev, (prev.state.player.x + cur.state.player.x) / 2, (prev.state.player.y + cur.state.player.y) / 2) != 'D' && (tile(prev, (prev.state.player.x + cur.state.player.x) / 2, (prev.state.player.y + cur.state.player.y) / 2) != '=' || prev.state.gateOpen)

checks.rule: The player never stands in a solid tile
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D' && (tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '=' || cur.state.gateOpen)

checks.rule: Swapping tiles with an enemy costs a life
checks.expect: !any(cur.state.enemies, e => e.x == prev.state.player.x && e.y == prev.state.player.y && find(prev.state.enemies, f => f.id == e.id).x == cur.state.player.x && find(prev.state.enemies, f => f.id == e.id).y == cur.state.player.y) || cur.state.lives < prev.state.lives

checks.rule: Keys are only used up by opening a door
Every visible button is clickable
The timer drops by 1 per running tick
Reappearing gives 4 ticks of immunity
